title: Lactate threshold concepts: how valid are they?
claims: The review examines the different lactate threshold concepts used in endurance testing and training.
The concepts do not describe the same physiological intensity and cannot be treated as interchangeable.
Fixed blood lactate concentrations are arbitrary relative to an individual's maximal lactate steady state.
The validity of a threshold depends on the test protocol and the physiological construct it is meant to represent.
